boundaries: Lifetime counters freeze before teardown and include startup/warmup. Interior snapshots lie within 17–73 seconds after attempt registration, approximately inside the 5-second setup +10-second warmup +60-second measurement. Server/client use overlapping role bounds, with each actual selected endpoint and monotonic duration reported. These are neither exact 60-second window counts nor synchronized cross-role snapshots. Whole-role profiles include setup/warmup/cleanup; cumulative samples overlap and are not additive removable time. Instrumentation overhead is not removed.
counter_validation: All captured snapshots and final copies pass strict uint64/schema, per-stage member/packet conservation and snapshot/counter monotonicity checks; overflow/truncation is rejected. This does not claim a mathematical proof against multiple uint64 wraps between observations.
